question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> values (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ppm</mi></math>) for clean water (A) and polluted water (B) are expected respectively as:

solution.text: Clean water would have <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> a value of less than, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>ppm</mi></math> whereas highly polluted water could have a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>17</mn><mo> </mo><mi>ppm</mi></math> or more.
